exposure: repeated doses of vaginal PGE2 (Dinoprostone, Prostin(r))
outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 885 primigravid and multiparous women with singleton live fetuses who were admitted for induction of labor with vaginal PGE2.
finding: In primigravid women, more than two doses of vaginal PGE2 were associated with a higher rate of cesarean section, but no significant association was found with APGAR scores or neonatal intensive care unit admission; in multiparous women, repeated doses were not associated with a higher rate of cesarean sections or increased maternal/neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Repeated doses of vaginal PGE2 (more than two doses) were associated with a higher cesarean section rate in primigravid women but not in multiparous women (three doses).
